digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler, store compat layer, ticket schema
propositions: Single JiraConfig.project scalar prevents N tracker projects from sharing one codebase and one ticket store; inbound fetcher hard-wired to one project key, outbound applier aborts on cross-project mutations

Per-ticket project and repos fields must track which tracker project each ticket syncs to and which repos it belongs to, with tri-state (absent=legacy, empty=never-sync, explicit-key=sync-there) semantics mirroring file_impact_scope
Store-owned project mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json replaces per-repo lists to prevent each pass from seeing other projects' tickets as remote deletions against shared prev_snapshot.json

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate configured projects, issuing one JQL pair per project and one enrichment pass per project (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results into shared snapshot keyed by issue

Multi-project store must carry multi-project-bridge in .store-compat.json required_capabilities when mapping holds >1 project, with fail-closed read path refusing writes on older binaries lacking capability
Idempotent ensure unit seeds project mapping from current Backend.project as legacy default with zero events written; pre-feature store resolves absent project against recorded default
